m.aarti.tek: Victory to you, Lord Mahāvīra; victory to you, Master, Lord Mahāvīra. Leader of the world, giver of happiness, Lord of great depth.
m.aarti.pad1: You were born in Kuṇḍalapura, the son of Triśalā; your father was King Siddhārtha; gods and men rejoiced.
m.aarti.pad2: Lord of the lowly and treasury of compassion, you are the bringer of good; for the good of the world you took up self-restraint; the Lord is the benefactor of others.
m.aarti.pad3: You ended sinful conduct and showed the true path; you raised the banner of the dharma of compassion over the world.
m.aarti.pad4: Arjuna the gardener, Gautama and Śrī Candanabālā: their boat you carried across the world.
m.aarti.pad5: Your name is holy, the one that carries the world across; whoever meditates on you night and day, all his suffering is wiped away.
m.aarti.pad6: Ocean of compassion, your greatness is beyond compare. Jñānamuni sings your virtues and gives himself at your feet.
